guidebook.intro: Manya ebisolo by’oku faamu, eby’omu nsiko n’eby’awaka, era ogambe ekiriwo.

tips.title: Ekimu n’ebingi
body: Mu Luganda ente emu ne ente nnyingi kigambo kye kimu. Mu Lungereza bulijjo oyongerako **-s**: **one cow, two cows**, **a goat, many goats**.
Ebigambo ebimu tebikyuka: **one sheep, two sheep**; **one fish, many fish**.

tips.title: “There is” ne “there are”
body: **Waliwo** mu Lungereza kiba **there is** ku kimu ne **there are** ku bingi: **There is a lion. There are many animals.**
Okubuuza: **Is there a lion?** **Are there elephants?**

culture.title: Engaali
body: Engaali kinyonyi kya ggwanga: **The crested crane is Uganda’s national bird.** Eri ku bendera ne ku nkoofiira z’abaserikale.
